test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

CONCISE
solution: The correct answer is '**Brief**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Concise**' is '**Brief**'. • **Concise**: giving a lot of information in a few words; brief. (थोड़े शब्‍दों में काफ़ी सूचना देते हुए; संक्षिप्‍त) • *Example: He gave a clear and **concise** summary of what had happened.* • **Brief**: short or quick. (संक्षिप्‍त या अल्‍पकालिक) • *Example: a **brief** description...* . **Correct Answer:__** *Brief.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Modified**: to change something slightly. (किसी वस्‍तु में अंशतः परिवर्तन करना) • **Edited**: to prepare a piece of writing to be published, making sure that it is correct, the right length, etc. [(लेख आदि का) संपादन करना (भाषाशोधन, सामग्री का आकार नियंत्रण आदि करना)] • **Lengthy**: very long. (बहुत लंबा, दीर्घ) 2f:T4a8, The correct answer is '**for**'.
